connector.name: MCP by templated.email
connector.registryDescription: Create and manage Templated email templates from any MCP client - bring your own model.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.templated.email over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace email.templated, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Templated API key (tmpl_sk_...) from Integrations → API Keys
